“I’m a meme now. Some people are calling me a karen, other people are calling me an old fat lady, and other people feel bad that they run me over with their scooter. But either way, I’m happy to be doing it.”
GTA 6 is reportedly more stable and performs better on Xbox Series X than on the base PS5, according to experts at Digital Foundry.

GTA 6 impact on the gaming industry:

- Its fallout zone is causing weaker sales for other games this fall, and the impact could last until March 2027, as people continue playing and buying it
- God of War Laufey was delayed from February to May partially because Sony realized GTA 6 would become a historic success and its impact would last longer, according to Jason Schreier
- NBA 2K27 missed its sales expectations
- Player counts dropped in Fortnite, CoD and FIFA
- PS5 consoles have sold out in many retailers because a lot of people buy the console just just to play this game

Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick answers a question on when GTA 7 is coming during a recent interview:

“Once you get through several hundred hours of the most incredible fun you’ve ever had in GTA 6, ask the question again.”
